Negatives are the full stored transcripts (read from the DB at run time): every edit there is a false positive except the positives listed below. 'real_nohotword' positives are genuine Whisper mis-hearings found by re-transcribing the 74-minute video without hotwords (scripts/eval/retranscribe_without_hotwords.py) and aligning it to the stored transcript; their probability is Whisper's. 'synthetic' positives are hand-written plausible ASR confusions for terms that never occur in the video (probability unknown). split: tune = thresholds may be chosen on it, heldout = report only.
